criteria.borderline: A conventional reading is strong, but an alternate literal reading could materially change the result.
criteria.clear: The request determines one solid up to scoring-irrelevant rigid transforms or mirror equivalence.
exclusions: Bare unit labels are not treated as intent ambiguity; unit normalization is adjudicated separately.
Presentation-only orientation is not ambiguity when alternatives are congruent and scoring-invariant.
